testcase.name: all thirteen actions resolve exact existing canonical records
manual and mirrored handoff results keep handoff and execution references distinct
disconnected work uses its emitted execution_operation, not its internal executor episode anchor
runtime recovery opens its original message without requiring an execution or session
minimal references emitted by every other collector retain their canonical navigation
missing scope and unavailable actions never select a first session or another record
opening every target only invokes canonical inspection methods, including cleanup inspect
empty, duplicate or out-of-scope handoff and delivery responses fail closed
all execution scope fields and maintenance receipt references are revalidated
original approval and message scope are checked, and unavailable target performs no API call
historical execution is read by exact operation without enumerating current sessions
authorization failures propagate without fallback, retry or retaining another record
each canonical inspection forwards its cancellation signal
generic decisions send the reviewed revision and never retry a conflict
missing or invalid approval revision cannot submit a decision
same revision preserves native draft identity; native revision, digest and CAS changes reset it
